listen.title: Ôn intro, STAR, đọc prompt

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: Tell me about yourself, then speak one prompt.
unseen.vi: Giới thiệu, rồi đọc một prompt.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I'm a software engineer. I currently work on routing. I'm looking for more ownership.
unseen.vi: Engineer. Hiện routing. Tìm ownership hơn.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The situation was a search outage. I did a config revert. The result was 12 minutes.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Act as a senior engineer. Given this code, don't change unrelated files.
unseen.vi: Đóng vai senior. Với code này, đừng sửa file lạ.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Return only the patch. Be concise.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: This PR adds a guard. The risk is dropping legit retries. Please review that.
unseen.vi: PR thêm guard. Rủi ro bỏ retry hợp lệ. Nhờ review.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: What are you hoping this hire owns in six months?
unseen.vi: Sáu tháng nữa mong own gì ạ?

listen.methodVi: Ẩn chữ. Nghe 1–2 lần (video hoặc TTS). Làm task. Mới mở transcript. Shadow 3 lượt: nghe → nói theo → nói một mình.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'm a software engineer. I'm looking for more ownership.
dialogue.vi: Mình là engineer. Đang tìm ownership hơn.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.vi: Incident thứ Sáu. Khôi phục 20 phút.

dialogue.vi: PR thêm retry. Nhờ review timeout.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What does the first 90 days look like?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.vi: Tháng hai shadow on-call. Còn hỏi gì không?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.vi: Role này đo success thế nào ạ?

aiPrompt.scenario: Quiet review: YOUR intro, one STAR, then speak one prompt.
aiPrompt.system: You are a friendly teammate (or interviewer) at a software company. Speak natural meeting English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra workplace English so the learner practices listening. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: Act as a senior engineer; This PR…; I'm a software engineer; The situation was…; What's the team like?. If they ask you to slow down or repeat, do that. Ask one concrete detail about their real work (ticket, bug, PR, or project). Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Quiet review: YOUR intro, one STAR, then speak one prompt.
